newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine hires Coopers to advise on GM or Daewoo.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine hires Coopers to advise on GM or Daewoo.

text.p: Ukraine has hired an international consulting firm to help choose between U.S. carmaker General Motors or South Korea's Daewoo Group to invest in the AvtoZAZ car plant, a government minister said on Tuesday.
"We have hired Coopers & Lybrand to advise us on this decision," Vasyl Hureyev, Minister of Machine Building and the Military Complex, told Reuters.
"We hope a decision will be made by May 1," Hureyev added.
The east Ukrainian car maker, which requires about $1 billion in investment, has been seeking a strategic partner for about two years.
AvtoZAZ has an annual capacity of 150,000 small and medium-sized cars, but production fell to only 6,881 cars last year from 130,000 cars in 1992.
